items.prompt:
Which is a way humans can harm the environment?
A) Pollution
B) Sleeping
C) Reading
D) Breathing

steps: Pollution is a human impact on the environment.

items.prompt:
To monitor an impact means to:
A) Ignore it
B) Measure it, often over time
C) Increase it
D) Hide it
items.answer: B) Measure it, often over time

items.prompt:
To minimize an impact means to:
A) Reduce it
B) Increase it
C) Measure it only
D) Create it

One way to monitor water pollution is to:
A) Guess
B) Test the water quality regularly and compare results
C) Add more pollution
D) Ignore the river
items.answer: B) Test the water quality regularly and compare results

steps: Repeated water tests track pollution over time.

items.prompt:
One way to minimize air pollution from cars is to:
A) Drive more
B) Use public transit or cleaner vehicles
C) Burn more fuel
D) Remove all buses
items.answer: B) Use public transit or cleaner vehicles

steps: Cleaner transit options reduce car emissions.

items.prompt:
Why should a solution to reduce an impact be based on evidence?
A) Evidence is not needed
B) Measuring before and after shows whether the change helped
C) To make it slower
D) Evidence stops solutions
items.answer: B) Measuring before and after shows whether the change helped

steps: Measurements show whether the solution actually worked.

items.prompt:
A city passes a rule to cut pollution. The best way to know if it worked is to:
A) Assume it worked
B) Measure pollution before and after the rule and compare
C) Ask no one
D) Pass another rule
items.answer: B) Measure pollution before and after the rule and compare

steps: Comparing measurements before and after shows the effect.

items.prompt:
What are the basic steps of an evidence-based environmental solution?
A) Change, then forget it
B) Measure the impact, make a change, then measure again
C) Guess and hope
D) Only measure once
items.answer: B) Measure the impact, make a change, then measure again

steps: Measure, change, and measure again to check the result.
